findings.finding: [config.py:1] — DB_PASSWORD is a hardcoded credential in source → every repository reader obtains the database password
[app.py:6] — copies the database password into AUTH_SECRET in the process environment → secrets leak to child processes and crash dumps
[auth/login.py:41] — concatenates caller input into a shell command with shell=True → arbitrary command execution as the service account
[utils/helper.py:19] — calls datetime.utcnow(), deprecated since Python 3.12 → emits DeprecationWarning and blocks a clean upgrade to future Python versions
[auth/login.py:13] — password comparison might leak timing → timing side channel on credential checks
